title: 'Plane will be hijacked': Note found in toilet triggers mid-air scare on IndiGo flight
content: Passengers aboard IndiGo flight 6E 451 from Bengaluru to Lucknow experienced panic after a hijack threat note was found. The note was discovered in the aircraft toilet around thirty minutes after take-off, prompting immediate action. Cabin crew alerted the pilot, who decided to return to the Kempegowda International Airport for security checks. Security agencies conducted a thorough search, declaring the threat a hoax after ninety minutes.

title: Adkar, Bhosale become first Indian women's pair to reach final at main WTA Tour level
content: India’s Vaishnavi Adkar and Rutuja Bhosale made history at the Chennai Open, becoming the first all-Indian women’s pair to reach a main WTA Tour doubles final. They defeated second seeds Weronika Falkowska and Alana Smith 6-2, 2-6, 10-8 after a thrilling comeback in the super tie-break. They will face Swiss duo Naima Karamoko and Simona Waltert in the final.

title: Tech exec murder: Victim's son hid behind parked cars as accused fired 15 rounds
content: Mohan Sharma allegedly shot his neighbor Paramjeet Dhankar following a dispute over vehicle parking. The altercation escalated after Dhankar's family previously reported tensions with Sharma's family. Eight days before the incident, repeated arguments occurred between both families regarding parking and a pet dog. Dhankar had just returned from Singapore to attend a family wedding when the shooting took place.

title: Zuckerberg pledged to donate 99% Meta shares; here’s the open letter they wrote
content: Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan have committed to donate a significant portion of their wealth to philanthropy. Their initiative focuses on advancing human potential and promoting equality for future generations. They aim to address challenges like disease, education, and internet access through long-term investments. The couple believes technology plays a crucial role in effecting positive change in communities.

title: Zelenskyy says Russia hit Ukrainian energy facility with North Korean KN-23 missiles
content: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that Russia is using North Korean KN-23 missiles against Ukraine. He emphasized the need for stronger global sanctions against countries supplying military assistance. Zelenskyy noted a critical shortage of US-made Patriot missile interceptors affecting Ukraine's defense capabilities. Russia's intensified attacks are exacerbating the situation as winter approaches. Military cooperation between North Korea and Russia has significantly increased in recent months.

title: UK manager fired over £21,000 pothole bills wins £34,326 unfair dismissal case
content: A Dundee transport manager who worked for a furniture company for over 24 years was dismissed after it questioned £21,360 in pothole repair bills. A tribunal found that the company had failed to investigate the matter fairly, overlooked findings that cleared him of wrongdoing and wrongly dismissed him. It ordered the company to pay him £34,326.

title: Michael Dell is funding South Korea's most-expensive divorce ever
content: Michael Dell is investing $406 million in SK Group by purchasing shares from chairman Chey Tae-won. This transaction involves a 1.34% stake in SK Inc, aimed to fund a divorce settlement. Chey Tae-won is selling shares totaling 944 billion won to pay his ex-wife. The investment showcases Dell's connection to SK Group through their partnership in technology infrastructure.

title: Happy Diwali 2026: Vibrant Wishes, Messages, Quotes, Images to Share on WhatsApp
content: As Diwali 2026 approaches on November 8, the air fills with the spirit of celebration and unity among families and friends. Known for its enlightening traditions, the festival bathes homes in light through diyas and colorful adornments. Emphasizing sustainability this year, communities are reminded to engage in meaningful acts of kindness, celebrating the true essence of joy and gratitude in every small moment.

title: Divyanka, Vivek name twins Daivik and Vaidvik; Diwali reveal charms fans
content: Divyanka Tripathi and Vivek Dahiya recently revealed the names of their twin sons after five months. They organized a unique clue-based game for their family to announce the names Daivik and Vaidvik. Divyanka shared insights into the meanings and significance of each name for their children. The couple expressed their joy and growth as new parents while navigating this exciting phase together.

title: How Donna Kelce brought Travis and Jason Kelce to tears after Super Bowl LVII
content: After a heartbreaking loss in Super Bowl LVII to the Chiefs, Jason Kelce reflected on the emotional moments shared with his brother, Travis, who celebrated winning the championship. Their mother, Donna, captured the audience's attention as the event unfolded. In a touching moment post-game, Jason embraced Travis, encouraging him to relish the victory, emphasizing that their bond as brothers and family was more important than the game's outcome.

title: 'A pleasure to watch him bat': Pathan hails KL Rahul's composure in tricky chase
content: KL Rahul proved to be a linchpin for India's ODI squad during the encounter against New Zealand. His unbeaten innings was pivotal amidst the early dismissals of his teammates, securing India’s victory through the DLS method. Meanwhile, New Zealand faltered at the crease, setting a modest target, while India's bowlers delivered with precision and vital wickets. Ultimately, India triumphed by a narrow margin of four runs despite challenging match conditions.

title: 10 yrs of JJ Act: Has the law helped kids reform or pushed more towards adult trials?
content: India's Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015 emphasizes child rehabilitation over punishment. However, the effectiveness of juvenile homes and legal safeguards remains questionable after ten years. Significant issues include staff shortages and delays in processing cases, which hinder timely interventions. Many children are still not receiving adequate education and support in institutional care settings.

title: Why can't Congress break free from Gandhi family? Sonia responds to nepotism charge
content: Sonia Gandhi addressed questions about her family's leadership of the Congress party during an interview. She downplayed allegations of nepotism while asserting the party's potential to challenge the BJP. Gandhi reflected on her mother-in-law Indira Gandhi's Emergency decision and described it as a mistake. She recounted personal trauma from losing both Indira and her husband Rajiv Gandhi to assassinations.

title: Muhurat Trading 2026: Why Dalal Street opens for an hour on Diwali
content: Muhurat Trading will occur on Sunday, November 8, signaling the beginning of Samvat 2083. This trading session reflects auspiciousness associated with the Diwali festival and investor optimism. Major indices have seen strong rallies leading up to this event, driven by foreign investments and stable domestic economic indicators. Analysts recommend focusing on quality stocks and maintaining disciplined asset allocation for the upcoming year.

title: Messi spotted with personalised bag featuring every club he played for except PSG
content: Lionel Messi has sparked debate among football fans after being spotted carrying a personalised mate bag featuring the crests of Barcelona, Inter Miami, Newell’s Old Boys and Argentina, but notably excluding Paris Saint-Germain. The omission has fuelled speculation about his relationship with the French club, where he spent two seasons between 2021 and 2023 before joining Inter Miami.

title: Europe is rehearsing its next move in Ukraine, and Putin may not like what comes next
content: A significant military drill named KOALICJA 26.2 is set to unfold in Europe, aimed at reinforcing Ukraine's security landscape in a post-war context. Military forces from 11 different nations will engage in combined operations spanning land, air, and maritime areas. The exercise seeks to bolster international cooperation amongst these nations for future engagements.

title: Ayodhya glows with 30 lakh diyas as Deepotsav lights up Saryu ghats on Diwali eve
content: Lakhs of diyas illuminated Ram Ki Paidi ghat, while more than 30 lakh earthen lamps were set to light up 56 ghats along the river, turning the temple town into a spectacular sea of lights. The annual celebration, which marks return of Lord Ram to Ayodhya after defeating Ravana, recreates the traditional welcome believed to have been given to him by the people of the city in the Treta Yuga.

title: Watch: Gukesh visits famous Tirumala temple ahead of World C'ship title defence

The 14-game championship will take place in Geneva from November 24 to December 12. Both players will be 20, making it the youngest World Championship clash in chess history. The tournament carries a USD 2.5 million prize fund.

title: 'Iron Gate': US forms special task force to restrict Iran's land exports
content: The United States has established Task Force Iron Gate to disrupt Iran's land and Caspian Sea weapons transport. This task force will operate from Tampa, Florida, involving approximately 20 personnel from various US government agencies. The initiative aims to further restrict Iran's capabilities to finance terrorism and rebuild military resources. Washington continues its naval blockade, reportedly preventing over $25 billion in crude oil exports.

title: Police outpost blast: Kashmir-linked outfit claims attack; ATS probes terror angle
content: An explosion occurred outside the Vasundhara police outpost in Ghaziabad's Indirapuram area on Friday night. Investigators suspect a possible terror angle after a group claimed responsibility for the attack. Forensic teams collected evidence, and CCTV footage is being analyzed to track suspicious activities. A local food delivery executive suffered minor injuries, while no police personnel were harmed in the blast.

title: Bend it like Brar: Fiery Gurnoor heats up Wellington
content: The conditions were helpful for the pacers, but the ball still needed to be put in the right areas, and Brar did the job with aplomb. He wasn't carried away by the extra bounce, movement in the air or nip off the surface. Instead, he adjusted well to the "trampoline"-like uneven bounce and carry from the playing surface and ran through the opposition with some serious heat.

title: Healthcare, Iran war & tariffs: Resurgent Democrats set stage to confront Trump
content: With a new majority in Congress, Democrats are gearing up to dismantle many of President Trump's policies. Their main priorities include overhauling healthcare, addressing the Iran situation, and tackling trade tariffs. The Democratic leadership aims to move quickly once Congress convenes on January 3, though they may encounter obstacles due to the Senate's 60-vote limit. There is potential for bipartisan collaboration on healthcare subsidies.

title: Kaun Banega Crorepati 18 shoot halted for a week amid Amitabh Bachchan’s health concerns

Recently, an episode featuring actors promoting Ramayana was aired for Diwali week. His return to the filming schedule depends on his health improving next week. Amitabh has expressed his gratitude to fans for their support during his health challenges.

title: EXCLUSIVE | 'Cricket, outside the NFL, is the largest media property in the world'

title: Accused arrested for shooting tech excecutive over parking dispute in Haryana

The two families had ongoing tensions for several days prior to the incident. Paramjeet, who had recently returned from Singapore, was attending a family wedding. After the shooting, the accused fled from the scene, and police are currently searching for him.

Railway police reported no complaint has been lodged regarding the incident at any police station.

title: 11 defeats against India in 2026: NZ register unwanted record after 2nd ODI loss

title: Trump's makes nuclear push in space exploration, sets 2-yr deadline for Nasa's Mars mission

This ambitious mission is set to pioneer advanced nuclear-electric propulsion technology, critical for future exploration efforts. With a focus on returning astronauts to the Moon, the subsequent establishment of a human presence on Mars signifies America’s commitment to ambitious space ventures, aiming to harness the potential of nuclear propulsion for deep space travel.

title: NYC marathon runner Rachel Apa's family shares obituary after her death at 24
content: family releases heartbreaking obituary for 24-year-old runner who died during marathon in NYC . family says she suffered from rhabdomyolysis, a rare condition involving the breakdown of muscle tissue . "with determination, discipline, and a heart fully committed to whatever she pursued," family says .

title: IAF Gajraj makes world-record landing at 13,629ft in Ladakh
content: IAF's IL-76MD makes history with highest-altitude landing at 13,629 feet in eastern ladakh . successful landing at Nyoma airbase, barely 25km from the Line of Actual Control, marked "the most successful landing ever achieved by the aircraft anywhere in the world" the aircraft was inducted in 1985 and nicknamed Gajraj .

title: Wangchuk accuses Ladakh admin of witch-hunt & smear campaign
content: sonam Wangchuk accuses ladakh administration of "witch-hunting" him . he is a member of leh Apex Body, a representative body of the people of Ladakh . the climate activist allegedly raised his voice for the youth of the country .

title: 'First apologise to devotees, saints': UP CM ahead of Akhilesh's Ram Temple visit
content: akhilesh Yadav is scheduled to visit the temple in ayodhya on dec 12 . the chief minister says those who had fired on Ram devotees should apologise . he said those who subjected saints to lathicharge should first acknowledge past actions .

title: Data protection law faces scrutiny: Key concerns explained
content: the digital personal data protection Act, 2023, is facing a legal challenge from the Digital News Publishers Association (DNPA), which represents 21 news organisations . the association has approached the Supreme Court, arguing that several provisions of the law could restrict journalistic activities, compromise confidential sources and undermine the right to information framework .

title: Indian-American Priya Sundareshan elected Arizona Senate president
content: Priya Sundareshan, 42, has served three terms in the state Senate . she was the minority leader in the outgoing chamber . her election comes as Democrats secure control of both legislative chambers and the governor's mansion .

title: 'Keeping Sanjay in check could have prevented damage': Sonia Gandhi on Emergency
content: Congress parliamentary party chairperson describes imposition of the Emergency as a mistake . she believes her mother-in-law and then prime minister Indira Gandhi eventually came to regret the decision . "i always feel that Mrs (indira) Gandhi was a democrat at heart," she said .

title: Stephen Curry’s $31 million property was sold at a loss
content: Stephen Curry and his wife, Ayesha, have been able to build a profitable investment portfolio in the last decade . the four-time NBA champion paid a whopping $31 million for a luxurious 17,000+ square feet mansion in atherton, California . it has seven bedrooms, nine bathrooms and a two story atrium .

title: At least 6 killed, 15 injured in Poland shooting; gunman shot
content: a gunman opened fire in a busy market square in the second-largest city of Krakow . the shooter is a Polish national, police say . he was shot and wounded during an exchange of fire with police .

title: Big houses & temples: How Indians are reshaping US county infamous for racist past
content: forsyth county now has 52,000 Indian residents, making up 16% of its population . they form the second-largest ethnic group in the area, behind white residents, who make up 63.5% . the expansion has not always been welcomed by everyone . community leaders say limited social interaction between Indian immigrants and white residents has contributed to resentment .

title: Digital arrest: When intelligence falls prey to basic instincts
content: a government report describes cybercrime in india as having evolved from a "distant threat" to a pervasive everyday reality . the cJI orally observed while hearing a suo motu case on digital arrests . it often begins with an unfamiliar voice on the phone, claiming that the person has been implicated in a crime .

title: Kimberly Guilfoyle reportedly moves in with ex-husband after Greece exit
content: 57-year-old reportedly moved into florida home of her second ex-husband . she had been given three weeks to vacate the property after her departure last month . source: "it's not surprising that Eric would be there for Kim" a source tells the Daily Mail that she's staying with her ex, who shares a son, Ronan .

title: 'Run bulldozer over our bodies': Mamata protests after 'attack' on Abhishek's house
content: motherta banerjee staged a protest outside her nephew's residence in Kolkata . she accused the BJP and the police of intimidating political opponents . the protest followed allegations that BJP-backed miscreants had attacked abhishek's home .
